[IDSP.3.2] Action arguments: `(type-name, slot1, slot2, ...)`,
arriving as typed values:

| Arg | DS type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| type-name | String | Look up the schema in the engine's schema registry |
| slot1..N  | per slot's declared DS type | Int/Float/String/Bool/Json; SCHEMA-ref returns DS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED until E6 |
